coverage: Absent/duplicate/foreign UUIDs and references; wrong partition types, names and geometry.
Bounded XML; unsafe entities and incomplete snapshots.
Equivalent full-span LABEL alias, shifted/truncated aliases and cycles.
Replayed kernel/session values, missing entropy, incomplete or legacy later checkpoints.

actual_kernel_observation.scope: Real x86 retained diagnostic RAM-root boot with uname and kern.geom.confxml probes; no full CURRENT media.

retained_failure.reason: The kernel exposed identical GPTs through the raw disk and ISO LABEL alias. Initial selection refused ambiguity.
retained_failure.correction: Canonicalize only proven full-span zero-offset LABEL aliases to the same physical provider and partition byte range; retain different-disk duplicate UUID refusal.

limits: This is an in-memory selection/correlation library. It does not open or write selected devices.
Raw GPT CRC/identity, FAT/map ownership, mounted/busy state and identity revalidation around device access remain required before any write.
RNG absence returns an unadmitted correlation; ordinary boot and installation must remain available.
Actual init/installer writers, complete bounded log retention, power-loss, physical hardware, canonical lifecycle and final media remain open.
